items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

items.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
items.summary: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

items.title: Zcash developers set January target for quantum-resistant payments after ‘bunker mode’ scare
items.summary: The plan concerns public payments, where about seven in 10 ZEC sit. A separate wallet tool would keep balance checks from revealing which addresses belong together.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered to around $82,500 after Trump ruled out an Iran strike, but remains about 4% lower on the week, while ether has lost 9%.

items.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
items.summary: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

items.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
items.summary: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than bitcoin despite ether’s market value being less than a fifth as large.

items.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
items.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

items.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
items.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

items.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

items.title: Dark web drug market operator sentenced to 40 years, forfeits $101 million in bitcoin
items.summary: A man from Virginia, who facilitated millions of drug transactions worth roughly $430 million, agreed to give up $100 million worth of BTC. His partner forfeited nearly 1,600 BTC.

items.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
items.summary: The bitcoin miner’s transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.

items.summary: Meanwhile has signed 15 brokers serving high-net worth clients across markets iSwitzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE.
